2610.11605.title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
2610.11605.paper_summary: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.
2610.11605.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 NanoProof，據我們所知，它是第一個在 Lean 4 中的分解執行引導定理證明器，其訓練數據、提取工具、訓練流程和權重均已公開，實現了使用開源資源的端到端可重現性。為此，我們構建並發布了一個結構化證明樹的數據集，以及一個在 Lean 4 形式驗證器中進行程式互動和數據提取的工具。為了支持可持續研究，我們專注於計算效率，以促進可訪問的訓練和評估。NanoProof 在 MiniF2F-Test 上達到了 50.8% 的 pass@16，超過了其類別中最接近的兩個系統，HyperTree Proof Search 和 ABEL，計算效率分別低了約 90 倍和 7 倍，並且使用的計算資源比 AlphaProof 少了超過四個數量級。雖然存在更強大的開放權重證明器，但它們是從大型預訓練語言模型中微調而來，並且不釋放訓練數據或流程；NanoProof 顯示了分解執行引導類證明器可以用適度的資源從頭開始重建。
2610.11605.author: Matěj Kripner et.al.
